RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.label: regroup and return
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.telegraphText: A lone scout was seen at the edge of your land, studying your defenses before slipping away. Someone is coming back to look harder at what beat them.
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.letterText: {0} did not forget what happened last time. This is the same enemy, returned to try you again.

RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.label: the allies arrive
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.telegraphText: News of the fight has reached {0}'s allies. Livery not your enemy's own has been sighted on the roads.
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.letterText: {0} comes because of what you did to their friends. The debt is not yours alone to settle.

RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.label: scavengers on the field
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.telegraphText: Desert scavengers circle the field where the bodies still lie unburied. Something else has noticed too.
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.letterText: The Junkers were never going to let good salvage rot. They come for what {0} left behind — and for whoever else is still standing on it.

RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.label: they come for their own
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.telegraphText: Fragments of encrypted chatter have been intercepted, naming your colony and one of your prisoners by description.
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.letterText: Whoever you are holding is worth coming for. {0} has sent a raid to take them back.

RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.label: Sh'kaar's escalation
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.telegraphText: The heat has teeth today. A bell you have never heard tolls somewhere aboard, and the sun does not look away.
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.letterText: Sh'kaar has noticed you. Every old wrong you are owed is coming due at once.

RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.label: Zizzik's aftermath
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.telegraphText: A chartreuse flicker runs through the ship's old lights, three quick pulses, gone before anyone else sees it.
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.letterText: Something in the walls has found the wrong wire at the wrong moment. Zizzik was already close when it happened.

RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.label: the rooted receipt
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.telegraphText: The exit-lights flare violet for a moment and the hull coughs once, deep in its bones, as if remembering it used to move.
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.letterText: A trader who visited recently has told the wrong people exactly where you sit. Ta'Baa marks another quadrum you did not fly.

RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.label: the reckoning
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.telegraphText: A Hutt envoy's letter has reached you, naming a caravan, a date, and a sum. The tone is not a request.
RimMandrake.Aftermath.RM_AftermathRuleDe.letterText: The Hutt Cartel was watching, and being watched means being owed. The reckoning has arrived.
